task: Deprecate the /api/v1/users endpoint across all consuming microservices and redirect traffic to /api/v2/users. Candidate pool from a 160-entry store across 9 services.

candidate_memories.content: Audit shows 4 services still calling /api/v1/users: order-svc, notification-svc, analytics-svc, and report-svc.
v1 endpoint returns snake_case fields; v2 returns camelCase. All consumers must update field parsing before cutover.
The v1→v2 migration guide is in docs/api/v2_migration.md; includes a field mapping table and code examples.
auth-svc uses /api/v1/tokens, a separate endpoint family not affected by the users deprecation.
API versioning policy: v1 endpoints receive 90-day deprecation notice before removal.
analytics-svc is owned by the data team; coordinate migration with them before their sprint ends Friday.
Old v0 endpoint /api/users was removed in 2024; services that referenced it were updated then.
candidate_memories.notes: stale: v0 removal completed, not relevant to v1→v2

candidate_memories.content: notification-svc rate-limits outbound API calls to 50/s; not related to endpoint migration.
Load balancer rules currently split traffic 80/20 between v1 and v2 for canary testing.
Breaking changes must be flagged in the API changelog with migration notes and a deprecation date.
report-svc is scheduled for retirement in Q3; minimal migration effort is acceptable for it.
Integration tests for v2 are passing in CI; v2 endpoint is production-stable.
